messages: maya: dropped a compact header mock — token pill + two icons (stop + regen). attached. quick thoughts on label semantics and SR behavior? design-bot: uploaded image compact-header-tokenflow.png :framed_picture: sam: eng notes: token updates are noisy at 200-300ms. throttle to ~1s and use fixed width to avoid layout shift. stopping action currently aborts the stream; if we label it 'Pause' we'd need resumable state. emily: copy take: avoid 'Stop' (ambiguous). prefer 'Interrupt' or 'Cancel'. tooltip for screen readers: 'Interrupt generation — preserves current partial output'. visible microcopy for pill: 'Tokens: 1,234'. liam: a11y nits: wrap streaming text in aria-live="polite" and throttle announcements. visual token pill should be aria-hidden="true" and expose an sr-only announcer updated on completion or milestones (eg every 50/100 tokens). do not announce every update. ensure contrast >=4.5:1. maya: UX question: on Regenerate do we clear previous output or keep it while loading? sam: keep previous output visible, overlay a translucent spinner with label 'Regenerating' — less destructive and better for comparison. emily: microcopy decision proposal: - primary: 'Interrupt' - secondary: 'Regenerate' - token tooltip: 'Tokens used in this conversation' - sr-only live text: 'Tokens used: {n}' updated on completion/milestone liam: +1. also add a completion announcement 'Generation complete' in a polite live region. provide a user setting for continuous announcements for long streams. maya: implementation checklist: - debounce token updates to 1s and fix width (sam) - change label to 'Interrupt' and add i18n keys + tooltips (emily) - add aria-live polite for stream + completion announcements (liam) - preserve output during regenerate with spinner overlay (sam) sam: will open a small PR. snippet for sr-only region I'll include: ```html Tokens: 1,234 Tokens used: 1234 ``` emily: i'll push the copy keys to i18n branch. liam: drafting a11y test steps and will add to QA doc. maya: thanks — labeling agreed (Interrupt), token pill visible+debounced+sr-only announcer on milestones, preserve content on regen. posting updated mock later. :thumbsup:
